player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I entered a loop between Utility room and Game room, revisiting the Cellar prematurely, and incorrectly listed "Utility room" twice in the nodes list. I also stopped too early without verifying if all reachable rooms were visited. Next time, I will maintain a strict set of unique visited nodes, avoid moving back to a room I just came from unless necessary for exploration, and only output "DONE" when the set of visited nodes equals the total count of unique rooms discovered. I will also ensure the graph edges are formatted as lists of tuples (e.g., `["A", "B"]`) and nodes contain no duplicates.
